environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on EC2 instance (i-0a3b7c9d2e1f4a5b6) in us-east-1, running behind an ALB (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:loadbalancer/app/prod-api-lb/50dc6c495c0c9188). Security group sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8 allows inbound TCP 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No path-based routing restrictions on the ALB listener rules. The application serves as the origin for CloudFront distribution E2QWRUHAPOMQZL but the origin is also directly accessible via the ALB's public DNS name. No authentication middleware configured on the /api/debug/* routes.
